description.value:
You can cast Illusion spells without providing Verbal components, and if an Illusion spell you cast has a range of 10+ feet, its range increases by 60 feet.

You also know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMinorIllus]{Minor Illusion} cantrip; if you already know it, you learn a different Wizard cantrip of your choice. This cantrip doesn't count against your number of cantrips known. You can create both a sound and an image with a single casting of Minor Illusion, and you can cast it as a Bonus Action.

Foundry Note

If you already knew Minor Illusion, replace the granted copy with another Wizard cantrip.
